productTopology.retainedMain: VDP, Brake Health, Tire Health; no changes
productTopology.vision: Camera Access OEM component plus Perception and Assessment assigned through a separate Vision Subject

ownership.carla-ego-runtime: Owned sensor, nonblocking capture/JPEG, bounded HTTPS media endpoint and selected-source media authorization
ownership.aos-vehicle-platform: Internal Camera Access ingress adapter, bounded multipart parsing and existing local OEM IPC
ownership.aosedge-sdv-demo: Existing Source owner supplies verified selection/credentials, starts/stops ingress and owns the named M4 campaign
ownership.nativeAos: Unchanged application resource allocation and Camera Access component lifecycle

hostEndpoint.listener: Existing Gateway TLS listener; same enrolled authority/port and TLS server name, no new listening port
hostEndpoint.visibility: Enabled only by the closed Vision Source profile; absent on Main
hostEndpoint.partMetadataHeader: X-Aos-Camera-Metadata; one compact JSON object with the existing Camera Access frame metadata fields
hostEndpoint.bindingHeader: X-Aos-Camera-Binding; sourceId/sourceEpoch/cameraId/calibrationId and the Source assignment generation

authorization.transport: Mutual TLS using the existing per-instance Source trust owner
authorization.client: Only the selected Vision Unit/node's existing SELECTED_PLATFORM_UNIT identity and exact enrolled fingerprint
authorization.newScope: Explicit Vision camera-read grant; existing VISS telemetry permissions do not imply media permission
authorization.guestCredentialOwner: Existing Source credential projection and systemd LoadCredential; no second CA/store, new leaf, key rotation or Main-key copying
authorization.credentialConsumer: Internal OEM ingress adapter only; no key access for the Camera Access core or Aos applications
authorization.quota: Separate bounded media-session slot; preserve existing VISS role limits. Both channel classes participate in Source quiescence and detach.
authorization.revocation: Source detach/reassignment closes media before acknowledging; failed/expired/unselected identity cannot reconnect

guestAdapter.logicalComponent: Internal part of the Camera Access OEM package, not another Cloud service or VM
guestAdapter.process: Separate nonroot process with empty capabilities and NoNewPrivileges; narrow camera-ingress SELinux domain
guestAdapter.credentialSeparation: Camera core keeps its current identity/domain and receives no TLS credentials; shared UID alone is not credential isolation
guestAdapter.localDelivery: Existing /run/aos-camera-access/oem/producer.sock with hello/select/frame/disconnect and current componentEpoch
guestAdapter.peerIdentityGate: Prove the exact nonroot producer UID allowed by the existing OEM socket and isolate its credential/network permissions; no broad UID-0 or unconfined fallback
guestAdapter.lifecycle: Normal Source and native/systemd owners only. Start after valid Source enrollment and active Camera component; stop/drain for Source detach and Camera replacement.
guestAdapter.network: Outgoing connection to the enrolled Gateway media endpoint only; no guest network listener
guestAdapter.parser: Bounded streaming multipart parser; reject duplicate/unknown required framing, oversized metadata/body, inconsistent length and invalid JPEG metadata before local IPC
guestAdapter.restart: Fresh authenticated Gateway/source binding after either process restarts; no recorded-frame fallback

capture.clock: CARLA_WORLD_SNAPSHOT_FRAME_MATCH with unchanged sensor time and at most 75-ms disagreement
capture.sourceIdOwner: Existing Source lifecycle binds the selected Gateway/camera session; no Unit identity guessed from a frame
capture.sourceEpochOwner: Gateway mints a fresh UUID on capture/stream restart, actor/source replacement or reset; old epoch is rejected
capture.calibration: Bind the actual rigid mount/intrinsics/crop/profile digest; no borrowed homography or camera configuration by a consumer

failureSemantics: Lost/stalled/invalid media clears or ages out pixels to UNAVAILABLE/WARMING/stale by the existing Camera contract; no synthetic timestamps, clock-domain subtraction, replay or automatic quality reduction. Cloud loss remains distinct from local media loss.
executionAfterAcceptance: Cascade accepted interface/trust changes into owning requirements/ADR/D4 and freeze source pins
Implement offline protocol/authorization/queue/reset cases before any live mutation
Compile only affected Gateway/adapter targets on SSD; rebuild neither CARLA nor Main Factory
Run one bounded reversible live proof on the current M4 Vision VM through the normal Source owner, including negative identity/generation, disconnect/reconnect and Camera restart
Verify the actual Aos reader receives matching live JPEG pairs; preserve existing Cloud Unit, Subject, data and all retained instances
Restore all transient code/policy and stop owned runtimes; record live versus source-only/image acceptance separately
deliveryBoundary: No rootfs rewrite, overlay rebase or replacement VM. A required permanent image/policy delta needs a separately accepted delivery route preserving the current VM; transient proof is not permanent image acceptance.
excluded: SSH replay relabelled as product ingress
